Quick answers to common queries about reaching us, our consultation process, and what to expect when you contact DH Construction.

Yes, absolutely. We offer a free site visit and consultation for all enquiries. Our team will visit your property, understand your requirements, and provide a detailed written estimate — all at no cost and no obligation.
How quickly will I receive a response?
We respond to all enquiries within 24 hours. For urgent requests, calling or WhatsApp-ing us gets you an instant response. We'll schedule a site visit at your convenience within 1–2 business days.
Do I need to prepare anything before the site visit?

Not necessarily, but it helps to have a rough idea of what you want changed, any reference photos (from Pinterest or Instagram), and your budget range. If you have existing floor plans, keep those handy too.
Can I get a quote over the phone without a site visit?

We can give you a rough ballpark range over the phone based on your description. However, an accurate and binding estimate requires a site visit to assess the current condition, measurements, and specific requirements.
What if I'm located outside Chennai?

While our primary service area is Chennai and its suburbs, we do take on projects in nearby areas like Kanchipuram, Chengalpattu, and Tiruvallur. Contact us with your location and we'll let you know if we can help.
Can I visit your office without an appointment?

Yes, you're welcome to walk in during our office hours (Mon–Sat, 8 AM – 7 PM). However, for a detailed discussion about your project, we recommend scheduling an appointment so we can dedicate proper time to your requirements.

Got questions about your renovation project? Here are answers to the most common ones we hear from our clients.
How much does a home renovation cost in Chennai?

It depends on the scope and materials chosen. A basic bathroom renovation starts from ₹60,000, a kitchen from ₹1.5 lakhs, and full home renovation from ₹8–10 lakhs. We provide a detailed, itemized quote after a free site visit.
How long does a typical renovation take?
Bathroom renovations take 10–15 days, kitchen remodeling 15–25 days, and complete home renovation 30–60 days depending on the area and complexity. We commit to a timeline upfront and stick to it.
Do I need to vacate my home during renovation?

Not always. For single-room renovations (kitchen or bathroom), you can stay. For full home renovation involving electrical and plumbing overhaul, we recommend temporary relocation for safety and convenience.
Do you handle permits and approvals?
Yes, for renovations involving structural changes, we guide you through the necessary approvals from the local municipality or panchayat. For interior-only work, permits are typically not required.
What materials do you use? Can I choose my own?

We use premium-grade materials from trusted brands. You're absolutely welcome to choose your own materials, tiles, fixtures, and finishes — we'll source them at the best prices and handle all procurement.
Do you provide a warranty on renovation work?
Yes, we provide a workmanship warranty of 1–2 years depending on the type of work. Waterproofing carries a separate manufacturer warranty. We also offer post-handover support for any issues.

Got questions about our interior design and fit-out services? Here are answers to the most common ones.
How long does a typical office fit-out take?

For a standard office of 2,000–5,000 sq ft, the fit-out typically takes 25–45 days depending on the complexity. Larger spaces or custom designs may take 45–60 days. We provide a detailed timeline before starting work.
Do you provide 3D designs before starting work?
Yes! For all premium and luxury packages, we provide detailed 3D visualizations so you can see exactly how your space will look before any work begins. Essential packages include basic layout plans.
What is the minimum area you work with?
We handle projects starting from 500 sq ft upwards. There's no maximum limit — we've done everything from small cabins to entire corporate floors of 20,000+ sq ft.
Can I use my existing furniture in the new design?
Absolutely. We integrate your existing furniture into the new design wherever possible. Our designers will assess what can be reused and suggest complementary pieces for a cohesive look.
Do you offer warranties on the work?
Yes, we provide a 1-year warranty on all fit-out work including false ceilings, partitions, and furniture. Electrical work comes with a 2-year warranty. Extended warranty options are also available.
Can work be done on weekends or after hours?
Yes, for operational offices and commercial spaces, we can schedule work during weekends or after business hours to minimize disruption. This may have a small scheduling surcharge.

What is the typical timeline for an office fit-out?

Do you work during weekends or after office hours?

Yes, this is one of our key advantages. We can schedule work during weekends, nights, or holidays to ensure zero disruption to your ongoing business operations. A small scheduling surcharge may apply.
What's included in a turnkey office fit-out?

Our turnkey package includes partitions (glass/gypsum), false ceiling, flooring, electrical & lighting, data cabling, painting, furniture installation, glass doors, branding wall, and professional cleanup — everything needed for a move-in ready office.
Can you work with our existing office layout?

Absolutely. We can reconfigure your existing layout, add new partitions, upgrade ceilings, or refresh flooring and painting. Partial fit-out and renovation services are available for offices that need upgrades without a full rebuild.

Is toughened glass safe for office partitions?

Absolutely. We use 12mm toughened (tempered) glass that is 4-5 times stronger than regular glass. If it breaks, it shatters into small, blunt granules instead of sharp shards — making it completely safe for office environments. All our glass is IS 2553 certified.
Can I add blinds or frosted film to glass partitions?

Yes, both options are available. We offer integrated between-glass blinds (sealed within double-glazed units), manual roller blinds, and frosted/etched vinyl films. Films can be full frosted, gradient, or custom-patterned with your branding.
How much weight can a glass partition hold?

A standard 12mm toughened glass partition with proper U-channel fixing can safely hold light loads like blinds, small shelves, and whiteboards. For heavy loads (TV screens, storage), we use reinforced framed systems with additional support brackets.
Can gypsum partitions be removed later?

Standard gypsum partitions are fixed structures and removal involves demolition — but they cause minimal damage compared to brick walls since they're lightweight. If you need re-locatable walls, we recommend our demountable partition system which can be unbolted and re-installed elsewhere.
Do partitions need ceiling to be done first?

Not necessarily. In most projects, we install partitions and false ceiling in parallel — the partition top channel integrates with the ceiling grid. This parallel approach saves 5-7 days compared to sequential work. Our team coordinates both work streams simultaneously.
What's the difference between acoustic and regular gypsum?

Regular gypsum partitions use single 12.5mm boards on both sides of a steel frame — providing ~30 dB sound reduction. Acoustic partitions use double boards (2×12.5mm on each side) with mineral wool insulation inside the cavity — achieving 40-50 dB reduction, making conversations inaudible outside.

Common queries about false ceiling materials, painting processes, and maintenance.
How long does a false ceiling last?

A well-installed gypsum false ceiling lasts 15-20 years without any issues. The key factors are quality of framework (GI thickness), proper screw spacing, and joint finishing. We use 0.40mm GI framework which ensures long-term stability. Popcorn or textured ceilings may need refreshing every 8-10 years.
Does false ceiling reduce room height?

Yes, typically 4-6 inches of height is lost. For a standard 10ft ceiling, the finished height becomes approximately 9.5ft. For low-height rooms (below 9ft), we recommend perimeter tray ceilings that drop only the edges, keeping the center at full height while still hiding services.
How many coats of paint are actually needed?

The standard professional process is: 2 coats putty + 1 coat primer + 2 coats emulsion = 5 total layers. Some dark colors may need 3 coats of emulsion. We never skip steps — each layer serves a specific purpose (filling, sealing, color coverage, durability).
Can AC vents and fire sprinklers be integrated?

Absolutely — this is one of the primary reasons for installing a false ceiling. We coordinate with your AC contractor and fire safety team to create precise cutouts for supply/return vents, cassette AC units, fire sprinklers, smoke detectors, and CCTV cameras. All openings are finished with proper trim rings.
What's the difference between POP and gypsum ceiling?

POP (Plaster of Paris) is hand-applied wet material — great for decorative elements like medallions, cornices, and curved designs but slower and messier. Gypsum boards are factory-made panels screwed to a metal frame — faster, cleaner, more consistent, and better for large flat areas. We use both depending on the design requirement.
Is false ceiling safe during earthquakes?

Gypsum false ceilings are lightweight (approximately 8-10 kg per sq meter vs 240 kg for brick) and flex with the building during seismic activity. They don't add significant load to the structure. However, they can crack at joints during strong tremors — which is repairable. We use proper cross-bracing in the framework for added stability.
